info.title: SwapIt Marketplace API
info.description:
REST API for the SwapIt PHP marketplace — buy, sell, swap, and auction items.

## Authentication
Most write endpoints and user-specific reads require a JWT Bearer token obtained from `auth.php?action=login` or `auth.php?action=register`.

Pass it as: `Authorization: Bearer <token>`

## Response envelope
All responses are JSON. Successful responses always contain `"ok": true`. Error responses contain `"ok": false` and an `"error"` string.

tags.name: Auth
tags.description: Registration, login, email verification, password reset

tags.name: Listings
tags.description: Browse, create, update, and delete listings

bearerAuth.description: JWT obtained from login or register. Include as: `Authorization: Bearer <token>`

body.example: Someone placed a higher bid of 120.00 JD.

Forbidden.description: Authenticated but not authorized for this action

post.description:
Authenticate with email and password. Returns a JWT token on success.

Rate-limited to 5 failed attempts per 15 minutes per IP.

example.error: Please verify your email before logging in.

error.example: Too many failed login attempts. Please try again in 15 minutes.

post.description: Create a new user account. Sends a verification email. The account is in `unverified` status until the email is confirmed.

message.example: Account created! Please check your email to verify your account.

post.description: Verify a user's email address using the token sent during registration. The token can be supplied in the JSON body or as a GET query param (for direct email link clicks — both methods hit this same ?action=verify URL).

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: Verification token — alternative to JSON body, used when following email links

message.example: Email verified successfully! You can now log in.

post.description: Re-send the verification email to an unverified address. Always returns the same generic message to prevent email enumeration.

200.description: Request processed (same response regardless of whether email exists)

message.example: If this email exists and is unverified, a new link has been sent.

post.description:
Initiate a password reset by emailing a reset link. Always returns the same generic response to prevent email enumeration. The reset token expires in 1 hour.

> Note: In the PHP source this action is named `forgot_password`; the recommended short alias is `forgot`.

message.example: If this email is registered, a reset link has been sent.

post.description:
Set a new password using the token received via the forgot-password email. Token expires after 1 hour. New password must be at least 8 characters.

> Note: In the PHP source this action is named `reset_password`; the recommended short alias is `reset`.

message.example: Password updated successfully. You can now log in.

400.description: Invalid or expired reset token, or password too short

get.summary: Browse / search listings (or get single listing)
get.description: Returns a paginated list of active listings with optional filters. When `?id=X` is provided, returns the full detail for a single listing and increments its view counter.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Return single listing detail instead of a list

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Full-text search on title and description

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Category ID (integer) or slug (string)

parameters.name: city
parameters.description: Partial city name match

200.description: Listing list (or single listing when ?id= is provided)

post.description:
Create a new listing. The `type` field determines which additional fields are required:
- `sale`: requires `price > 0`
- `auction`: requires `start_price > 0`, `starts_at`, and `ends_at` (ends_at must be after starts_at)
- `swap`: `swap_notes` is optional

description.example: Works perfectly, minor wear on body.

swap_notes.example: Looking to swap for a DSLR lens.

ends_at.description: Required when type=auction; must be after starts_at

value.title: iPhone 14 Pro
value.swap_notes: Will swap for an Android flagship.

put.description: Partially update a listing. Only the owner or an admin may update. Send only the fields you want to change. Status can only be set to `active` or `draft` (not `removed` or `sold`).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of the listing to update

delete.description:
Soft-deletes a listing by setting its status to `removed`. Only the owner or an admin may delete.

Blocked if:
- The listing is an auction that is `live` and already has bids
- The listing has pending swap offers

409.description: Conflict — active auction with bids, or pending swap offers

example.error: Cannot delete a listing with an active auction that has bids.

get.summary: Get bids for an auction listing
get.description: Returns all bids for an auction listing, ordered by amount descending. Bidder usernames are masked for unauthenticated viewers. Your own bids are shown in full when you are authenticated.

parameters.name: listing_id
parameters.description: ID of the auction listing

post.description: Place a bid on a live auction. The bid amount must be strictly greater than the current bid (or `start_price` if no bids have been placed yet). You cannot bid on your own listing.

422.description: Bid too low, auction not live, or missing fields

example.error: Bid must be higher than current bid of 150.00

get.description: Returns all swap offers for the authenticated user, split into `received` (offers made to you) and `sent` (offers you made) arrays.

post.description: Propose swapping your listing for another user's listing. Both listings must be `active`. You must own `offered_listing_id` and must not own `wanted_listing_id`. Duplicate pending offers for the same pair are rejected with 409.

offered_listing_id.description: Your listing that you are offering

wanted_listing_id.description: The listing you want in return

message.example: Happy to add some cash if needed!

example.error: A pending offer already exists for these listings

put.description:
Update the status of a pending swap offer.

| action | Who can do it |
|---|---|
| `accepted` | Receiver only |
| `rejected` | Receiver only |
| `countered` | Receiver only (can update `cash_addition`) |
| `cancelled` | Sender only |

When **accepted**: both listings are marked `sold` and all other pending offers involving either listing are auto-rejected.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Swap offer ID

cash_addition.description: Updated cash amount — only used when action is `countered`

example.error: This offer is already 'accepted' and cannot be updated.

get.summary: List conversations (or get messages in one)
get.description:
**Without `?conv_id`**: returns all conversations for the authenticated user, ordered by most-recent activity.

**With `?conv_id=X`**: returns paginated messages for that conversation and automatically marks unread messages as read.

parameters.name: conv_id
parameters.description: Conversation ID — include to retrieve messages

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (only used with conv_id)

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Messages per page (max 100, only used with conv_id)

post.description:
Send a message. Two modes:

**Reply** — provide `conv_id` + `body`. Returns 200.

**New conversation** — provide `receiver_id` + `body` (+ optional `listing_id`). If a conversation between the two users already exists, the message is appended to it. Returns 201.

conv_id.description: Existing conversation ID (use this OR receiver_id)

receiver_id.description: User ID — starts a new conversation if one doesn't exist

listing_id.description: Optional listing context for new conversation

201.description: Message sent and new conversation created

get.description: Returns the authenticated user's wishlist ordered by most-recently-added. Each item has an `available` flag that is `false` when the listing is no longer active.

post.description: Add an active listing to the authenticated user's wishlist. You cannot wishlist your own listing. Duplicate entries are silently ignored (INSERT IGNORE).

delete.description: Remove a listing from the authenticated user's wishlist. Pass the listing's ID as a query param.

200.description: Removed (no error if entry did not exist)

get.description: Returns up to 50 of the authenticated user's notifications, newest first. Pass `?unread=1` to filter to unread only. Always includes the total unread count.

parameters.name: unread
parameters.description: Set to 1 to return only unread notifications

put.description:
Two modes:
- `?id=X` — mark single notification as read
- `?action=mark_all` — mark all unread notifications as read

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Notification ID to mark as read (use this OR action=mark_all)

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: Use `mark_all` to mark every unread notification as read at once

get.description: Returns all reviews for the given user along with their average rating, review count, and a star-level breakdown (1–5 stars).

post.description: Submit a rating (1–5) and optional comment for a user. You cannot review yourself. Duplicate reviews for the same reviewer + reviewed_id + listing_id combination are rejected.

comment.example: Excellent seller, item exactly as described.

listing_id.description: Optional — scopes the review to a specific transaction

delete.description: Delete a review by its ID. Only the original reviewer or an admin may delete. Recalculates the reviewed user's aggregate rating after deletion.

get.description: Returns all top-level categories with their nested sub-categories as a tree. When `?id=X` is provided, returns a single category and its direct children.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Return a single category with its children instead of the full tree

get.summary: Get user profile, public profile, or dashboard
get.description:
Three sub-modes (authentication required for all):

| Params | Returns |
|---|---|
| *(none)* | Authenticated user's own profile (includes email, phone) |
| `?id=X` | Public profile for user X (their active listings + received reviews) |
| `?action=dashboard` | Auth user's full activity: all their listings, bids placed, and swap offers |

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Return the public profile for this user ID

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: Use `dashboard` to get the authenticated user's full activity summary

put.description:
Update the authenticated user's profile. All fields are optional — send only those you wish to change.

To change the password, include **both** `current_password` and `new_password`. The new password must:
- Be ≥ 8 characters
- Contain at least one uppercase letter, one lowercase letter, one digit, and one special character
- Be different from the current password

post.description:
Upload one or more images for a listing you own.

- **Accepted types**: JPEG, PNG, WebP
- **Max size**: 5 MB per file
- **Storage**: `public/images/uploads/{listing_id}/`
- Set `is_primary=1` to make the first uploaded file the listing's primary image (resets the previous primary).

listing_id.description: ID of the listing this image belongs to (must be owned by the authenticated user)

images.description: One or more image files (JPEG / PNG / WebP, max 5 MB each)

is_primary.description: Set to 1 to mark the first uploaded file as the primary image

get.description:
Admin-only GET endpoint. Select the operation via the `action` query param.

| action | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `stats` | Dashboard summary counters |
| `users` | Paginated user list (search, role, status filters) |
| `listings` | All listings including removed (status, search filters) |
| `reports` | Content reports (status filter, default: open) |

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (applies to users, listings, reports)

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search by username/email (action=users) or title (action=listings)

parameters.name: role
parameters.description: Filter users by role (action=users only)

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by status. users: active|suspended|unverified. listings: active|draft|sold|removed. reports: open|reviewing|resolved (default: open)

put.summary: Admin — update user status or report status
put.description:
Admin-only PUT. Select operation via `action` + `id`:

- `?action=user&id=X` — change a user's `status` to `active`, `suspended`, or `unverified`. Admins cannot change their own status.
- `?action=report&id=X` — change a report's `status` to `open`, `reviewing`, or `resolved`.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: User ID (action=user) or Report ID (action=report)

status.description: New status value. For action=user: active|suspended|unverified. For action=report: open|reviewing|resolved

delete.description: Force-removes any listing by setting its status to `removed`, regardless of ownership. Use `?action=listing&id=X`.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Listing ID to remove
